matrix.obligation: A page job completes while unrelated work remains blocked: no rerun before settlement, exactly one after, without global drain.
Force settlement between timeout and fallback; bind generation A before waiting. If same query generation B is admitted later, A remains ready and B remains pending independently.
Four admitted jobs reject fifth; one slot frees while unrelated work remains, fifth watcher becomes ready. Polling never admits the fifth itself.
Another session admits the rejected query while total admitted stays four; same-query coalescing is useful progress. Unrelated refill with no usable query state must not cause repeated reruns.

With full queue, fresh exact/threshold-compatible result or fresh terminal error can make the rejected query useful; wrong root/account/mode/scope/window must not. Expired >2s result cannot become complete.
Pure capacity probe mirrors normal expired-inactive-other-root retirement; blocked active roots stay protected. Probe does not actually evict cache or change LRU order.
Repeated polls do not call request, builder, Query.normalized, filesystem resolution, retry callbacks, or diagnostics; admission/cache/error/timestamps remain unchanged.

Pending generation may settle as source_changed/invalid_record and trigger one redraw. The terminal result has no progress callback; polling never clears errors. Existing 2s error-cache/request semantics and explicit retry generation guards remain unchanged.
Retain fast-sibling expiry behind slow work: original verification epoch remains; >2s is reverified or stale, never relabeled complete. Preserve 4s foreground bound and 30s stale limit.

Shared generation wakes every affected session independently. Nested sections and duplicate handles produce one watcher and one per-render latch; latch set before rerun. Exception/stop and next render clear prior ContextVar state.

At most four service events and sixteen page probes; no Future/payload retention, no growing generation history. Overflow stops retaining probes and enables one legacy fallback. Optional field default/positional/equality/repr compatibility preserved.

Close marks queued and active progress signals even if an active builder is blocked; next render is service_closed. Polling creates no replacement worker or new service. Service weakref can expire safely.

historical_evidence: v65 four timeouts and v64 failures retained; reproduced global-drain coupling is not proven sole cause of all live failures.
